events.title: Demo 0.32
events.summary: Demo Update 0.32 is live!Changelog v0.32Pacing & Gameplay: Improved the overall pacing of the demo by increasing the balloon's speed.General: Minor bug fixes and improvements.Thank you all for playing the demo and providing feedback!Fly safe,Pierpiero.

events.title: Demo 0.21
events.summary: Demo Update 0.21 is live!Changelog v0.21New Hints: Added new in-game tips and hints.Localization: Improved and refined several translations.Bug Fixes: Fixed an issue that sometimes prevented clicking "Continue" after reading the story intro.Thank you all for playing the demo and providing feedback!Fly safe,Pierpiero.

events.title: Demo 0.18
events.summary: Demo Update 0.18 is live!A new update for the demo is now available, focusing on localization fixes and improved readability for in-game instructions.Changelog v0.18Hot Air Balloon Instructions: Fully localized all text and notes regarding the balloon controls and mechanics.Text Fixes: Resolved various typos, formatting issues, and translation errors across several in-game texts.Thank you all for playing the demo and providing feedback!Fly safe,Pierpiero.

events.title: Demo 0.17
events.summary: Hey.I've just updated the demo to make the first experience with the hot air balloon a bit smoother.Changes:Added extra instructions explaining the controls and dashboard indicators.You can no longer die at the beginning of the game, giving you time to get familiar with the balloon.Added a refueling system at the starting station, so you don't have to worry about fuel while practicing.Enjoy the demo!

events.title: The Altitude Zero Demo Is Now Available!
events.summary: The Altitude Zero demo is now available!This is just a small taste of what awaits you in the full game.If you give it a try, I'd love to hear your feedback. And if you enjoy it, don't forget to wishlist Altitude Zero! It really helps the game's development.Thank you for your support, and enjoy the demo! Pierpiero.
